description: List Space messages after an optional since sequence (id, seq, body, kind). Does not advance the unread cursor. has_more means call again with since set to the last seq. Space sequence numbers are shared with non-message events (Articles, board, summaries), so gaps in the message seqs are those events, not missing messages. Prefer this over receive_unread_messages when you only need to browse. REST: GET /v1/messages. Idempotent.

since.description: Return messages after this Space sequence number; omit to start from the beginning.

name: list_messages
title: List messages
